blocks.orig: The tented camp of One Nature Nyaruswiga in Serengeti National Park will leave you wanting nothing more. The tents are beautiful and very spacious, with lush furniture in a classic style, beautiful bathrooms and outside showers. The comfy big sofas, the fourposter beds filled with pillows, the wood fire inside the tent, the classic bathtub openly in the bedroom next to that fire… it all speaks of a luxury that you will rarely find somewhere else. The camp has 12 tents designed for 2 -3 guests and 2 family tents for up to 6 sleeping guests. Besides, it boasts a lush lounge area, a restaurant with white linen, beautiful china, crystal glasses and silver chandeliers, and an infinity pool with a jacuzzi. On top of that, there is an astral observation deck where you can have your dinner with the telescope right next to you for your stargazing.
blocks.html: At One Nature Nyaruswiga, a tented camp in Serengeti National Park, you will have nothing left to wish for. The tents are lovely and extremely roomy, furnished in a rich classic style, with beautiful bathrooms and outdoor showers. Large comfortable sofas, four-poster beds piled with pillows, a wood fire inside the tent and a classic bathtub standing openly in the bedroom beside it… all of this reflects a level of luxury you will seldom come across elsewhere. There are 12 tents for 2 -3 guests each and 2 family tents that sleep up to 6. The camp also has a sumptuous lounge, a restaurant set with white linen, fine china, crystal glasses and silver chandeliers, and an infinity pool with a jacuzzi. What is more, an astral observation deck lets you dine with a telescope beside you for some stargazing.

blocks.orig: Staying here feels like going back to colonial times, as you can play tennis on the grass of Serengeti, with your lunch and comfy chairs set up next to the court. The trading post sells all the safari clothes and necessities you might need. Enjoy your whiskey in the bar, play some vinyl on the old-fashioned gramophone, take a bath with a view before dinner or go for a massage in the spa. At One Nature all that and more is at your service!
blocks.html: A stay here takes you back to the colonial era: you can play tennis on the Serengeti grass while your lunch and comfortable chairs are laid out beside the court. Any safari clothing and essentials you need can be bought at the trading post. Sip a whiskey in the bar, put on a vinyl record on the vintage gramophone, have a bath with a view before dinner or book a massage at the spa. One Nature offers you all of this and more!
